objectives: Trainees correctly name the UML parts (class box, attribute row, method row, inheritance arrow).

Read the box width from the dimension (in cm).

tasks.expected: Add the missing method in the method row and check the signature; check the inheritance arrow direction and correct it to the parent class
tasks.prompt: A subclass uses behaviour that appears nowhere in the model: name two checkable causes in rows or arrow and one remedy each.

en.title: UML class (AE-1)

tasks.prompt: Una subclase usa un comportamiento que no aparece en el modelo: indique dos causas comprobables en filas o flecha y una solución para cada una.

es.title: Clase UML (AE-1)

objectives: Trainees correctly name the visualisation parts (bar field, comparison marker, swap arrow).

tasks.expected: Comparison marker

Read the height of the tallest bar from the dimension (in cm).

tasks.expected: Check the comparison condition direction and correct it; check the swap logic for a complete position swap and repair it
tasks.prompt: Sorting stalls although neighbours are wrongly ordered: name two checkable causes in comparison or swap and one remedy each.
